caption: Figure 20: Coupling of SW-C with Functional Behavior Models by the Converter For each direction the following different cases can be distinguished. • The initial creation of an empty functional behavior model (so called model frame), based on a software component description, and the update of an already existing functional behavior model (model frame including already model functional behavior) according to the changes in the software component description (see e.g. [ATBMUC0001] and [ATBMUC00018]). • The initial creation of a software component description, based on a legacy functional behavior model and the update of a software component description according to changes in the functional behavior model. (see e.g. [ATBMUC0007] and[ATBMUC0020]).
